when: a warehouse operator opens the home screen
then: an explicit "No stock at this location" empty-state message is shown instead of a blank page

independence.rationale: AC1 and AC2 cover the populated table (rows present, quantities aligned); AC3 covers the zero-record path, which can be broken (blank page) while the populated-table ACs stay green, and vice versa

architectural_notes: E2E covering the zero-record path: the boundary (app/routes) returns an empty collection from stock-service/stock-repository over an empty stock_records table, and the React SPA home component (client/) renders the explicit empty-state message rather than a blank region. The empty-vs-populated branch is a client rendering decision, owned by the presentation layer; the API contract simply returns an empty array (R5). Verified via a real-branch integration test asserting the API returns an empty result against a truncated table, plus a client component test asserting the empty-state message renders when no rows are returned.
